question: In which year did Rajpath become the permanent venue for the Republic Day parade?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1955**__.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The parade takes place every year on Republic day (26th of January) at Rajpath in New Delhi.
 
• Rajpath become the permanent venue for the Republic Day parade in 1955.
 
• The parade is being organised by the **Ministry of **Defence.
 
• The parade showcases a multi-hued image of the country's rich cultural heritage and military power.
 
• This parade is presided over by the President of India.
 
• The first Republic Day parade was held in 1950.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated '**Kartavya Path'** on 8th September,2022.
 
• It symbolises a shift from erstwhile Rajpath being an icon of power, to** Kartavya Path being an example of public ownership and empowerment**
